comment: One production branch per part (docs/plans/production-branches.md). `checks`: GitHub checks that must have passed on the commit, besides CI summary, before the branch changes. `paths` are relative to `base` (default 'Caller Whale CRM'); a branch holds only those, at those paths, plus .gitignore. `rust: true` adds the Cargo workspace file, cut down to the members present, and Cargo.lock. `images`: the container images built from the branch's files (.github/workflows/images.yml, step 47): `context` and `dockerfile` are paths in the branch; `buildArgs` maps a build argument to the repository's Actions variable that holds it.

components.name: landing-web-production
components.title: Landing site
components.build: npm ci && npm run build; Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8080, health /healthz. Set VITE_CALLERWHALE_AUTH_URL as a build variable (env/landing-web.production.example)

components.name: landing-dashboard-web-production
components.title: CRM web app (app.callerwhale.com): the desktop frontend built for the browser
components.build: Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /landing/dashboard-web/Dockerfile, port 8080, health /healthz, build args VITE_CALLERWHALE_AUTH_URL and VITE_CALLERWHALE_API_URL

components.name: auth-backend-production
components.title: Authentication service
components.build: go test ./... ; docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8101

components.name: notifications-backend-production
components.title: Notification service
components.build: go test ./... ; docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8102

components.name: mcp-backend-production
components.title: MCP connector service
components.build: go test ./... ; docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8106, domain mcp.callerwhale.com

components.name: crm-core-backend-production
components.title: CRM core
components.build: go test ./... (the database tests are skipped without CRM_TEST_DATABASE_URL); docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8107, no domain; no upload volume

components.name: messaging-backend-production
components.title: Messaging
components.build: go test ./... (the database tests are skipped without MESSAGING_TEST_DATABASE_URL); docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8108, no domain of its own

components.name: live-backend-production
components.title: Live server (Centrifugo with Caller Whale's settings)
components.build: node --test (config.test.mjs); docker build . Coolify: build pack Dockerfile, base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8000, no domain of its own (the gateway routes live.callerwhale.com to it)

components.name: dialer-sms-backend-production
components.title: Dialer and SMS (Telnyx, with a built-in simulator)
components.build: go test ./... (the database tests are skipped without DIALER_TEST_DATABASE_URL); docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8113, network alias dialer-sms, no domain of its own

components.name: importing-lists-backend-production
components.title: Import worker
components.build: python -m unittest discover -s tests; docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, no domain, no memory cap; its own persistent volume at /data/imports

components.name: assistant-backend-production
components.title: Website assistant
components.build: go test ./... ; docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8109, no domain of its own (the gateway routes assistant.callerwhale.com to it)

components.name: learning-backend-production
components.title: Learning store
components.build: go test ./... (the database test needs LEARNING_TEST_URL); docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8112, no domain; its own PostgreSQL resource

components.name: gateway-backend-production
components.title: Gateway
components.build: go test ./... ; docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8100

components.name: authz-backend-production
components.title: Authorization service
components.build: go test ./... ; docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8104, no domain

components.name: billing-backend-production
components.title: Billing service
components.build: python -m unittest discover -s tests (after pip install -r requirements-test.txt); docker build . Coolify: base directory /, Dockerfile /Dockerfile, port 8103, no domain

components.name: desktop-app-production
components.title: Desktop app: the frontend, the window container (Tauri) and the feature modules
components.build: npm install && npm run build in desktop/frontend/react; cargo test --workspace at the root (the feature modules); cargo build in desktop/container/rust. Their tests start the Skip Tracing engine from skip-engine-production: set CALLERWHALE_SERVICE_ROOT to its checkout

components.name: grafana-production
components.title: Grafana for Caller Whale's staff, behind the login proxy (Coolify)
components.build: go test ./... in services/grafana-proxy; in Coolify: a Docker Compose resource from this branch with deploy/grafana/compose.yml (deploy/grafana/README.md)

components.name: skip-engine-production
components.title: Skip Tracing engine (Python)
components.build: pip install -r requirements.txt pytest && python -m pytest
